name: What types of insulation are available for home remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What types of insulation are available for home remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common insulation types include fiberglass, cellulose, spray foam, and rigid foam boards. Fiberglass is widely used for attics and walls, available in batts or blown-in form. Cellulose, made from recycled paper, is dense and effective, often blown into cavities. Spray foam (open-cell or closed-cell) expands to create an airtight seal, offering excellent thermal performance. Rigid foam boards are suitable for specific applications like basement walls or exterior sheathing, providing high R-value per inch. The best choice depends on the area being insulated, budget, and desired R-value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types are fiberglass, cellulose, spray foam, and rigid foam boards, each suited for different applications and offering varying thermal performance.
